meta.fields: the new word; its peak F0, Hz; the highest other word's peak F0, Hz; that word; the line's words; its spoken span, s (the first word's onset to the last word's end: C25's words a second)
meta.measure: f0_word's peak: the largest of the word's voiced 40 ms frames (hop 10 ms, autocorrelation over 0.5), octave errors dropped (1.6 x its median), median-filtered over 3
meta.rule: on the peak: the new word's peak above every other word's (a tie is no peak)
